description: This file contains tests for the functions 'resolveOncharPrefixes' and 'stripOncharPrefix' related to the Mattermost monitor's on-character prefix handling. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify prefix resolution, trimming, and stripping behaviors.

methods.name: resolveOncharPrefixes
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a list of prefixes, providing default prefixes if input is undefined or contains empty strings after trimming.

methods.name: stripOncharPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the given text starts with any of the specified prefixes and, if so, strips the first matching prefix.
